semantic_constraints: GAIN and PALLOCATION have different physical meanings and must not be used interchangeably.
GAIN is injector-centric: it measures the fraction of an injector's injected water recovered as liquid production at a producer.
PALLOCATION is producer-centric: it measures the fraction of a producer's liquid production attributed to a specific injector.
GAIN below 0.05 is considered negligible and must not count as meaningful injector support.
For a balanced simulation, the sum of GAIN across producers for each injector must be less than or equal to 1.
The sum of PALLOCATION across injectors for each producer must be less than or equal to 1.
Produced water fraction and produced oil fraction must sum to 1, subject to numerical tolerance.

tables.name: connectivity_table
tables.description: CRM injector-producer connectivity results. Each row represents one modeled injector-producer pair.

columns.name: INJECTOR
columns.description: Injector well name (source).

columns.name: PRODUCER
columns.description: Producer well name (sink).

columns.name: GAIN
columns.description: Fraction of water injected by injector i that is recovered as liquid production at producer p. Denoted G_{ip}; it measures the strength of injector-to-producer support.

columns.name: PALLOCATION
columns.description: Producer allocation: fraction of the producer's total liquid production attributed to injection from this injector. The remainder may be attributed to other injectors, pressure changes, or primary depletion.

columns.name: GAIN_CLASS
columns.description: Categorical interpretation of GAIN: negligible for GAIN < 0.05, low for 0.05 <= GAIN < 0.15, moderate for 0.15 <= GAIN <= 0.70, and high for GAIN > 0.70.

tables.name: simulation_quality_table
tables.description: Producer-level CRM history-match quality metrics. Each row represents one producer model.

columns.name: PRODUCER
columns.description: Producer well name.

columns.name: CORRELATION
columns.description: Correlation between observed and simulated liquid-production time series.

columns.name: VARIANCE_RATIO
columns.description: Ratio of simulated production variance to observed production variance.

columns.name: QUALITY_SCORE
columns.description: Composite CRM history-match quality metric from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate better model quality.

columns.name: QUALITY_CLASS
columns.description: Categorical interpretation of model quality: very poor below 0.40, poor from 0.40 through 0.60, good above 0.60 through 0.80, and very good above 0.80.

tables.name: producer_model_table
tables.description: Producer-level summary of current production state, producer-specific CRM parameters, production-source decomposition, and injector support. Each row represents one producer.

columns.name: PRODUCER
columns.description: Producer well name.

columns.name: current_produced_water_fraction
columns.description: Current fraction of produced liquid that is water; also called water cut.

columns.name: current_produced_oil_fraction
columns.description: Current fraction of produced liquid that is oil.

columns.name: current_liquid_production
columns.description: Latest volume of liquid produced -total volume, not a fraction-

columns.name: current_liquid_production_due_to_depletion
columns.description: Recent liquid production attributed by the CRM model to primary depletion.

columns.name: current_liquid_production_due_to_injection
columns.description: Recent liquid production attributed by the CRM model to injection support.

columns.name: current_liquid_production_due_to_pressure
columns.description: Recent liquid production attributed by the CRM-P model to bottom-hole-pressure changes.

columns.name: TAU
columns.description: Producer-level CRM injection-response time constant. Smaller values indicate a faster modeled production response to changes in injection; larger values indicate a slower and more attenuated response.

columns.name: TAUP
columns.description: Producer-level primary-production decline time constant. Larger values indicate a slower modeled decline of the producer's primary or depletion contribution.

columns.name: LO
columns.description: Producer-level CRM coefficient controlling the magnitude of the modeled primary or depletion production contribution.

columns.name: pressure_coefficient
columns.description: Producer-level CRM-P productivity coefficient representing the sensitivity of modeled liquid production to bottom-hole pressure.

columns.name: total_allocation
columns.description: Sum of PALLOCATION over all injectors connected to this producer. Represents the fraction of the producer's liquid production attributed to modeled injection support.

columns.name: number_supporting_injectors
columns.description: Number of injectors with non-negligible GAIN (GAIN >= 0.05) connected to this producer.
